records.subject: Welcome aboard, Cedar Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for setting up Cedar Dynamics on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Cedar Dynamics* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Engaged, positive admin replied within a day [email:886a9065], first project reached day 0 and one invite sent, no tickets, 8 days left. But key milestone still unreached after 6 days and she only says she 'might' take a call, suggesting low urgency.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Great to hear the first week has gone well, and thanks for the update. Happy to do that walkthrough whenever it's useful.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so the usual next step after a first project is getting real work into it alongside your teammate.

Would a short call this week suit? I can walk you both through that first step live and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
